MIPS & Quality Reporting

A Missed Measure Today Is a Payment Adjustment Next Year

The Merit-based Incentive Payment System, MIPS, adjusts Medicare Part B reimbursement up or down based on performance across four categories: Quality, Promoting Interoperability, Improvement Activities and Cost. A low score doesn't just mean a missed bonus, it means a payment penalty applied to Medicare claims the following year.

Most practices lose points not because their care is poor, but because the reporting itself falls through the cracks: a measure never gets tracked, a submission deadline is missed, or documentation doesn't quite support the measure being claimed. The clinical work happened, it just never got captured in a way the program recognizes.

PMEX determines eligibility, selects the measures most likely to score well for your specialty, tracks performance data throughout the year, and handles submission before the deadline, so reporting reflects the care you're already delivering.
